policy: A new dependency is admissible only if it is permissive (BSD/MIT/Apache/ISC/Zlib/PSF family) AND not in a hard-excluded commercial/non-commercial agent-dataset family. Escalation is required for anything outside the permissive allowlist.

dependencies.name: cryptography
dependencies.note: Ed25519 signing/verify/receipt + RFC 3161 TSA. Installed explicitly in CI (pip install cryptography). Dual Apache/BSD, permissive.

dependencies.name: asn1crypto
dependencies.note: Conditionally imported for timestamp-authority verification. MIT, permissive. Not installed on the dev box (pod-side); declared so CI/audit knows its licence rather than treating an optional import as a gate.

dependencies.name: cbor2
dependencies.where: harness/scitt_verify.py (SCITT COSE_Sign1 CBOR decode + Sig_structure re-encode, RFC 9052/RFC 9943)
dependencies.note: The move-31 SCITT COSE_Sign1 verifier needs a CBOR decoder to turn a counted statement into a cryptographically verified one. MIT, permissive. Installed explicitly in CI (pip install cbor2).

dependencies.name: rfc8785
dependencies.where: harness/canon/jcs-python.py (module level), engine/dorado_sign.py:73 (deferred import in the to-be-signed canonicalisation path)
dependencies.note: JCS canonicalisation of the signing preimage. Apache-2.0 per the PyPI classifier 'License :: OSI Approved :: Apache Software License' (the license field is empty; the classifier is the authority). On the permissive allowlist.

dependencies.name: opentimestamps
dependencies.where: harness/ots-anchor.py:36,58-60 — ALL FOUR are function-local imports inside anchor()/verify(), never module level. It is an optional path, not a load-bearing dependency.
dependencies.note: DECLARED HONESTLY AND DELIBERATELY LEFT FAILING. python-opentimestamps is LGPL-3.0-or-later; permissive_allowlist_spdx is permissive-only, so this trips the sweep BY DESIGN. That is the gate working, not a bug. Three ways out, and only the owner picks: (a) invoke the `ots` CLI as a subprocess instead of importing the library — the ordinary LGPL boundary, and easy here because every import is already function-local; (b) drop the OTS path; (c) counsel widens the allowlist. Do NOT add LGPL to permissive_allowlist_spdx to make CI green — legal gates widen only via counsel.

internal_packages.name: csoai_city
internal_packages.note: Estate's own package (CSOAI), licensed Apache-2.0 by the estate; not an external third-party dependency — excluded from the external-licence sweep.

sweep.summary: Only permissive deps (cryptography cross-license, asn1crypto MIT, cbor2 MIT). No hard-excluded family appears in any code/data asset. The only repo mentions of the excluded families are in docs/NEXT-100-v3 where the rule itself is enumerated.
